judge.rationale: The candidate's runtime implementation of `accumulateUsage` is functionally identical to the reference, and its unit and acceptance tests thoroughly verify the multi-round accumulation and partial-undefined edge cases. It also properly updates `CHANGELOG.md` and `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md`. However, the candidate missed one acceptance criterion—and even checked off its own DoD facet without doing it: it left the `OrchestratorHooks.afterModelResponse` parameter named `usage?: UsageMetadata` and the local variable named `lastUsage`, whereas the reference renamed both to `totalUsage` (and synced the doc-blocks in `CLAUDE.md` and `specs/hal-engine-architecture/spec.md`) so the signature itself makes the summed behavior unambiguous. Minor structural differences include placing `accumulateUsage` in `orchestratorHelpers.ts` rather than inline in `chatOrchestrator.ts` and adding a separate `.acceptance.test.ts` file alongside `.lore/dod.md`.
